item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Slow Push Into Forest Cabin

turns.text: A realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn. Make a silent 6-second widescreen video, one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.

item.tests: Tests a sustained text-specified camera push with depth and foreground parallax rather than a static image or simple zoom.

answer_sheet.Source image: No attachment; create the scene from text.
answer_sheet.Scene and mood: A realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn, quiet and peaceful.
answer_sheet.Camera movement: A slow forward push toward the front door, with foreground trees showing depth as the camera advances.

must_haves: A realistic wooden cabin sits among pine trees in dawn lighting.
The camera advances smoothly toward the cabin's front door throughout the six-second shot.
Foreground trees shift relative to the cabin, visibly conveying forward movement through space.
The cabin and trees retain consistent shapes without scene changes or cuts.
The output is widescreen and silent.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a video of a realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn. I've had this kind of scene in my head for a while, and I'm curious to see it brought to life. What I mean is a silent, 6-second widescreen video, with the whole thing done as one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. I always worry that describing camera movement in words makes it sound more complicated than I actually mean. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Photorealistic little wooden cabin nestled among pine trees at dawn, natural early morning light and realistic wood textures. A single continuous shot: the camera slowly and smoothly dollies forward toward the cabin's front door at a constant gentle pace. Keep a few pine tree trunks in the near foreground along the edges of the frame; their natural parallax clearly conveys the camera moving forward. The front door remains the focal point. Simple restrained camera movement, no cuts, no transitions, no orbit, no sudden acceleration. Quiet natural scene, no titles or graphics.
